body: Follow-up to task 9611 (lane code-w, 2026-11-09): phases 1-2 of design #835 are merged — phase 1 journal gate (PR #4535) and phase 2 actor-authorized operations (PR #8034, merge d60169796346c71101b9b8d3ab467a337320f023: WorldCommand::RevokeAuthorized / InstallProgramAuthorized authorize the live JoinCapability in the serialized actor and derive the audit actor). Remaining is phase 3 of doc/2026-11-01_design_id835.md: joined-session frames and end-to-end proof. Make InstallBegin accept an omitted admin token only in joined builder sessions (reject mixed admin/session credentials; pre-join admin path unchanged); add a joined revoke { participant_id } ClientFrame routed to revoke_authorized; carry the optional actor_denied code on ServerFrame::Error for these denials; enforce builder Wasm-only installs (never the native installer); add real-session (SessionIo) tests for builder success, moderator success, guest denial with code actor_denied, expiry/revocation races (revoking a builder mid-upload prevents activation), journal attribution, and unchanged admin/upload safeguards (size/hash bounds, upload concurrency, source-only refusal).

acceptance: A joined builder installs a valid Wasm module through the real session upload sequence; journal records Committed + BuilderInstalled { by: derived } atomically
A joined moderator revokes via the new revoke frame; Revoked { by: Some(derived) } is durable before success is reported and the revoked session disconnects
Guests and invalid/expired/revoked capabilities are refused with wire code actor_denied; builder installs reject native artifacts
Existing admin pre-join install, upload bounds, and F11.13 code meanings unchanged; pkgs/id tests pass

dedupe.basis: Phase 3 of design #835 filed as its own implementation issue #8036 on 2026-11-09 by task 9611 completion; no live task exists for #8036.

evidence: doc/2026-11-01_design_id835.md phased plan: step 3 (joined-session frames) depends on steps 1-2, both now merged

issue.title: id: implement design #835 phase 3 — joined-session builder/moderator frames

payload.priority_reason: Final phase of design #835 for issue #5544; phases 1-2 landed 2026-11-08/09, session enablement is the remaining acceptance surface.
payload.problem: Design #835 phases 1-2 are merged but the session path is not enabled: InstallBegin still requires an admin token pre-join and there is no joined revoke ClientFrame, so builder/moderator authority is not yet usable over real sessions.

exclude: Design changes without filing a design amendment
Work outside pkgs/id unless the design explicitly requires it
include: pkgs/id/src/world_session: joined builder install via existing upload sequence, joined revoke frame, optional actor_denied error code
pkgs/id tests: real-session end-to-end coverage per the design acceptance criteria

tests: cargo test for pkgs/id (laptop or CI) passes, including new real-session tests for this phase's behaviour

title: Implement design #835 phase 3 for #5544: joined-session builder/moderator frames
